name: ANU2024 U7156805
author: ManindraDeMel
description:
Recommended to play with external mouse + keyboard

Pace Yourself - a high-octane roguelike survival game that challenges players to master advanced movement mechanics while managing scarce resources. Players alternate between tense resource-gathering phases and frantic escape sequences in a hostile world. The game features fluid parkour-style movement, including wall-running, slide-jumping, and other exciting mechanics to come. Players must collect weapons, evade pursuing enemies, and attempt to defeat the final boss... With permadeath and persistent progression between runs, each playthrough offers a unique challenge. The game's adaptive difficulty ensures a thrilling experience for newcomers and veterans, rewarding skill and strategy in equal measure.
